description.value:
“Of course you came back. You weren’t supposed to be there to begin with.”

Crossroads Hare (1/a Soma Break). When you would be reduced to 0 Integrity, you may choose instead to vanish into the place between places. At the start of your next turn, you reappear in any unoccupied space within 1 mile that you have personally visited and can clearly remember, with 1 Integrity and one level of Stress. You leave behind a single recognizable token at the spot you vanished from — a horn, a tuft of fur, a footprint that wasn’t there before.

The Rumor Runs Faster. Once per a Soma Break, you can spend 1 minute of focused Clarity hold to tell the GM what one nearby community is currently afraid of. The answer is at least one truth.
